chunks.subject: AP Research
chunks.title: Academic Paper exemplar — Sample I, 1/5
chunks.content: Sample I scored 1/5 (Report on Existing Knowledge). Topic: an overly broad inquiry into diabetes mellitus, obesity, and depression and their relationship to mood. The paper reports existing knowledge on a very broad topic without a carried-through method or a new understanding. Illustrates the 1 band: broad topic, report only.
